name: LeaseCriticalDatesTracker
tagline: Never miss a break, renewal or rent review notice deadline again.
description: Tracks lease critical dates for property portfolios: works out notice deadlines and option windows from lease clauses, shows RAG status, sends reminders based on per-type lead times, and records acknowledge / snooze / actioned with notes in one text column. Timeline, list and calendar views, .ics export, and a dedicated phone layout.
features: Notice deadline and option window maths (month-end safe)
RAG status with configurable thresholds and reminder lead times
KPI strip with click-to-filter tiles and next deadline
Timeline with option windows, key dates and lanes
Sortable list and month calendar with day agenda
Acknowledge, snooze, mark actioned with notes and reopen; audit trail in the bound column
Data-quality warnings, empty, loading, read-only and disabled states
Keyboard roving focus, ARIA tabs/grid, bottom sheet on phones
Custom labels, colours, locale and currency
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
